C0239.title: Wuhan Police Announce Typical Case of Online Disinformation About Heavy Rain
C0239.summary: In May 2026, during severe rainfall in Wuhan, a netizen surnamed Xu posted false claims on social media that 'Wuhan's torrential rain caused streets to flood,' attaching a flooding video from outside Wuhan to gain traffic. Police summoned Xu in accordance with the law and announced this typical case of spreading disinformation.
